:::{#exm-measure}
#### Counting elements is a measure

The counting function $\measure(A) \eqdef \abs{A}$ of @exm-finite-additivity,
defined on the $\sigma$-algebra of all subsets of $D$
(@exm-sigma-algebra),
takes values in $[0, \infty]$,
is countably additive (@exm-countable-additivity),
and gives $\measure(\emptyset) = 0$,
so it is a measure.

:::
